identity: Stillgrave keeps every grave labelled and every bone accounted for; this season the uncalled dead wander its furrows and a very confused gang is robbing the wrong graves.

quests.title: Flowers for the Wrong Guests
quests.text: We leave greenery for those who can no longer enjoy a meal, and the Gaunt Fawns have been enjoying it on their behalf. Cull eight by day on the {name:blightmoor}, {zone_area:blightmoor}. The mourners would like their offerings to last a little longer than the walk home.
quests.lesson: A local hunt; the legs armor choice (one enchant, item level 5).

quests.title: Borrow Has Had Long Enough
quests.text: {name:grave_robber_chief} has been treating our graves as a lending library, with no intention of returning anything. Kill six Grave Robbers and their chief at the {name:robbers_camp}, {dir_from_giver:robbers_camp}, where they keep watch day and night. An honest mourner might dig the wrong hole once; arriving with sacks suggests a settled intention.
quests.completion: Borrow has had his answer, and our dead may keep what is theirs. You have been good company for Stillgrave, which is more than I can say for most arrivals with a shovel. When you leave, let it be with our thanks and on your own feet.
quests.lesson: A camp pack plus a named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).

quests.title: Older Graves, Deeper Water
quests.text: Listen: for once, that is only the wind among the stones. Follow the road to Mournfen Village and speak with Mordec Silt; the graves in his care are older than ours, and the water is rising around them. Come back when you can, preferably on your own feet.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff to the home zone.
